mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id AS parentId, m.tenant_id AS tenantId, m.menu_code AS menuCode, m.menu_name AS menuName, m.route_path AS routePath, m.component_path AS componentPath, m.icon, m.sort_order AS sortOrder, m.permission_code AS permissionCode, m.visible, m.status, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.updated_at AS updatedAt, m.isdel FROM auth_menu m INNER JOIN auth_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN auth_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN auth_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.visible = true AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.isdel = 0 AND rm.isdel = 0 AND ur.isdel = 0 AND r.isdel = 0 ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC NULLS FIRST, m.sort_order ASC
